cohort: The study included 185 infants born at 22-23 weeks gestational age at a single tertiary care center between 2006 and 2023.
finding: Mortality in extremely preterm infants born at 22-23 weeks was associated with lower birth weight, SGA, and various severe medical complications, while cesarean delivery was associated with reduced mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with reduced mortality (OR: 0.3) in extremely preterm infants.
birth_weight: Average birth weight for non-survivors was 509 g, and for survivors was 564 g.
